notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (https://www.monoprix.fr/robots.txt) has no Claude/anthropic-specific rule and no blanket Disallow: / - only disallows cart/checkout/search/account paths, so tier (a) was fully usable. Fetched all pages via direct HTTP (requests + a real-browser User-Agent) against the SFCC/Demandware site; server returned full SSR HTML with product counts on every page - no JS rendering or Chrome tier needed. TREE: built the Maison (home) tree from the homepage mega-menu (all /c/maison/... links via regex over the raw HTML), then cross-checked two nodes whose full children were NOT in the mega-menu but only appear on the node's own landing page: /c/maison/buanderie-et-menage (5 children: cintres, menage, paniers-a-linge, pinces-a-linge-boites-de-rangements, repassage - child totals 18+29+6+11+15=79 = parent total, confirmed exhaustive) and /c/maison/salle-de-bain/linge-de-bain-et-serviettes (5 children: gants-de-toilette, peignoirs, serviettes-de-plage-foutas, serviettes-de-toilette, tapis-de-bain - child totals 18+10+4+28+28=88 = parent total, confirmed exhaustive). Per the parent-URL rule, the two parent pages themselves were NOT recorded as leaves since valid subcategories exist. H1 and self-referencing canonical were checked on every leaf fetched and matched the requested node. QTY: every leaf shows a 'jauge-and-showmore-wrapper' progress element with text 'NN produit(s) sur MM' (NN = number rendered in the initial SSR batch, MM = the site's own true total for that category); MM was recorded as qty in every row, never NN. Two DUPLICATE-LINK cases were found and de-duplicated per the duplicate rule (same product set reachable via two different nav paths, verified by comparing product image alt-text lists, not just matching counts): (1) /c/maison/chambre/linge-de-lit/dessus-de-lit-plaids-futons and /c/maison/chambre/plaids-futons-dessus-de-lit are the identical 19-product listing - kept only the linge-de-lit child, dropped the top-level Chambre duplicate; (2) /c/maison/salle-de-bain/linge-de-bain-et-serviettes/serviettes-de-plage-foutas and /c/maison/exterieur/plage/serviettes-de-plage-foutas are the identical 4-product listing - kept the Bathroom>Bath Linen copy, dropped the Outdoor>Beach copy (which left Outdoor>Beach with no remaining qualifying children after accessoires-de-plage was also excluded, so that whole branch was dropped as an orphaned parent). EXCLUDED (neither category): all of Arts de la table (assiettes/bols/verres/etc - Kitchen&Dining), vaisselle-jetable, poubelles-de-cuisine and poubelles-de-salle-de-bain (waste bins, not covered as storage), sacs-isothermes and sacs-pliables-poussette (carrying bags, not home storage), accessoires-de-cuisine other than boites-conservation (utensils/cookware), decoration-murale (miroirs/affiches/cadres - Wall Decor), objets-decoratifs non-textile/non-storage items (lampes, vases, fleurs, cache-pots, fleurs-sechees), bougies-et-parfums-dambiance, mobilier-enfant/luminaires-enfant, petit-electromenager (all appliances incl. repassage/ironing tools and aspirateur/vacuum), mobilier (all furniture incl. outdoor furniture), chat-et-chien (pet products, excluded per pet boundary), c/maison/outlet and its subtree (promotional/clearance aggregation pages, not standard category nodes), c/maison/tendances (seasonal/trend landing pages), accessoires-de-plage (single product = organic-cotton toiletry pouch, a personal carry item not home textile/storage), accessoires-de-salle-de-bain items other than rideaux-de-douche/boites-rangements (soap-dispenser holders, toothbrush holders, WC accessories, mirrors), buanderie-et-menage/cintres (plain clothes hangers, not listed as storage), buanderie-et-menage/menage (cleaning products) and /repassage (ironing tools). LOW/MEDIUM CONFIDENCE FLAGS: 'Pillows' (oreillers, 31) marked MEDIUM - the rules explicitly list pillowcases/shams/covers as Textile but not the filled pillow itself; included because the site groups it under 'Literie' directly alongside Duvets/Mattress Protectors, which the rules do list. 'Baskets, Chests and Boxes' (paniers-coffres-et-boites, 50) marked MEDIUM - sits under the 'Objets decoratifs' (decorative objects) branch rather than a Storage-labelled branch, but the category itself (baskets/chests/boxes) matches storage.md's storage-basket/box groups. 'Baskets' under Gardening (jardinage/paniers, 18) marked MEDIUM - product alt-text confirms genuine woven/rattan/seagrass storage-style baskets, but the category sits under Gardening rather than Storage/Organization. 'Clothespins, Storage Boxes' (pinces-a-linge-boites-de-rangements, 11) marked LOW - a single mixed listing page combining clothespins (not storage) and storage boxes (storage) with no way to split the count; flagged for review.
